name: structured-gist
description: Hierarchical lecture-note output skill. Replace verbose prose with structured, scannable outlines. Four-role marker hierarchy (concept → attribute → enumerator → explanation), three granularities (skim/standard/deep), two render modes (block/responsive), deterministic conformance linter.
